messages:
katie: CI alert — PR #19876 failed the microbench warmup job. batcher_warmup median latency went from 2.1ms -> 3.7ms (+76%), throughput 95rq/s -> 60rq/s (-37%). Threshold is 20%. @sanjay can you triage? :eyes:
ci-bot: [ci] eng-runtime/microbench-warmup failed on PR 19876. See job: https://ci.redwood.internal/eng-runtime/19876/artifacts
lucy: looking now. quick diff shows kernel-autoselect heuristics change in commit 7f1a2c3 touched the warmup path.
lucy: quick flame sample (local gprof):
```
kv_batcher::process_batch 46%
kernel_selector::choose 28%
copy_kv_cache 12%
gpu_dispatch 8%
```
lucy: the kernel_selector call stack grew and is calling a slower quantized path on many sequences during warmup.
sanjay: repro locally with `./run_microbench --bench=batcher_warmup --runs=100` — reproduces stable delta. attaching perf.data to thread.
sanjay: bisect -> narrows to commit 7f1a2c3 (the autoselect kernel scoring tweak). If I revert that patch locally, night-and-day improvement.
katie: is this a rollout-blocker? Canary showed ~10% tail regressions earlier today on the traffic shadow.
ci-bot: label applied: perf/regression, rollout-blocker
oliver: if commit is small we can revert quickly. I'll open a revert PR if you confirm the bisect.
lucy: confirm — the new scoring prefers the concat-kernel for short sequences which adds memcpy+copy_kv_cache overhead; in warmup distribution that wins too often. Might be a heuristics threshold bug.
sanjay: repro command I used: `./tools/run_microbench --seed=47 --profile=flame --target=batcher_warmup` (linux/x86: perf.data attached).
katie: plan: revert the autoselect change in a hotfix PR, run the microbench CI on the revert branch, then run canary shadow. If revert clears, we can rework heuristics behind a feature flag.
oliver: created PR 19890: revert kernel-autoselect scoring tweak — https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/19890 :rocket:
oliver: kicked off perf CI on revert branch. CI link: https://ci.redwood.internal/eng-runtime/19890
lucy: uploaded flamegraphs + side-by-side diffs to internal graphs: https://redwood.internal/graphs/7429998888/ — look at bucket 'warmup-short-seq'
katie: thanks. once CI green, deploy revert to canary then monitor cost/latency dashboards (console -> rollout tab).
sanjay: adding this to rollback checklist and running full regression suite now. Will post results in this thread.
katie: appreciate the quick turnaround :thumbsup: — marking as P0 until revert CI passes.
